bbl-apple:
import bpy, math
if 'Cube' in bpy.data.objects: bpy.data.objects.remove(bpy.data.objects['Cube'], do_unlink=True)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=24, ring_count=16, location=(0,0,1))
body=bpy.context.object; body.name='AppleBody'; body.scale=(1.0,0.9,0.85)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.03, depth=0.5, location=(0,0.05,1.9))
st=bpy.context.object; st.name='AppleStem'; st.rotation_euler=(0.1,0.15,0)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=0.3, location=(0.15,0.1,2.05))
lf=bpy.context.object; lf.name='AppleLeaf'; lf.rotation_euler=(0.4,0.6,0.3)
bpy.ops.object.shade_smooth()
mat=bpy.data.materials.new('AppleRed'); mat.use_nodes=True
mat.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF'].inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(0.55,0.08,0.02,1)
body.data.materials.append(mat)
